scientific_integrity: A fully analytic martingale argument supports infinite assertions; a deterministic exact-rational checker independently verifies finite-size drift and expectation formulas only. No finite computation is represented as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for one-edge initial data and linear degree-proportional attachment; it does not identify the distribution of the nondegenerate quadratic-degree martingale limit or extend to other kernels. An independent mathematical audit and exhaustive historical-priority assessment have not been performed.
title: Random second-order fluctuations of sibling-leaf pairs in preferential attachment trees
